title: Matoi Vanilla Pack "RePack by tcleo"
body:
Matoi Vanilla Pack (Repack for 1.14.4 & 1.15.2 & 1.16.5 & 1.17.1 & 1.18.2 & 1.19.4 & 1.20.1 & 1.21.1)

IMPORTANT NOTE: YOU MUST EXTRACT THIS PACK DIRECTLY INTO YOUR "config/immersiverailroading" FOLDER! DO NOT LEAVE IT IN THE "MODS" OR "RESOURCEPACKS" FOLDERS.

General Info:
This is a repack of the original Matoi Vanilla Pack, now compatible with Minecraft versions 1.16.5 and 1.21.1. It was originally created by tcleo. I do not claim ownership of the original pack. This version was created solely for user convenience and to ensure accessibility on these game versions.

Warning & Support:
Please be aware that you might encounter visual bugs with certain models. If you experience any glitches, model issues, or bugs, please report them by writing to petralexsievic@gmail.com.
